versions.changelog:
- Added explicit multilingual usage instructions (English and Portuguese) to the documentation.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No functional or technical changes to logic or workflow; documentation clarified.
- Version remains the same (1.0.0 in SKILL.md metadata).

Initial release of the SonarQube Review Skill — automate fixing SonarQube code quality issues for any language or framework.

- Automatically detects project stack (language, framework, test tool, coverage) via configuration analysis.
- Supports SonarQube Community, Enterprise, and custom deployments using prioritized environment variables.
- Generates issue fixes, adds/updates unit tests, and verifies test coverage with tailored scripts.
- Usage restricted to SonarQube issues; guides users toward the right skill for other quality scenarios.
- Includes dedicated stack support and validation for Angular and .NET projects.
- Provides scripts/templates for validation, local SonarQube scans, and stack detection as part of the workflow.
